Theorem
[Interpolation on a domain] 1. ch7:7.28\group ch07-sobolev-spacesSource: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0185 Let $\Omega $ be a $C^{1,1}$ domain, $u\in W^{k,p}(\Omega )$, $\varepsilon >0$, and $0<|\beta |<k$. Then \begin{equation} \tag {7.61} \| D^\beta u\| _{p;\Omega } \leq \varepsilon \| u\| _{k,p;\Omega } +C\varepsilon ^{|\beta |/(|\beta |-k)}\| u\| _{p;\Omega }, \qquad C=C(k,\Omega ). \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Extend $u$ by Theorem 7.25, apply Theorem 7.27 to the extension, and use the extension estimate (7.54).

□
